statement.excerpt: Generative AI might be steeped in the language of high fantasy, but it’s a tool, one that they will not admit is a terribly-flawed and unprofitable way to feed the growth-at-all-costs tech engine.
statement.document_title: Are We Watching The Internet Die?

our_interpretation: The ordinary empirical reading is that commercial generative AI had material reliability problems and its providers were not earning an overall profit.
The target is the commercial activity generally. OpenAI or Anthropic can provide examples but cannot alone establish an industry-wide result.

For the ongoing profitability assertion, use calendar 2023, the latest completed annual business period before publication. The speaker supplies no reporting cadence; this annual-period choice is an interpretation.
Unprofitable means overall profit after costs, rather than negative gross margin or cash consumption alone.
The speaker cites no financial figures or accounting framework in this passage, so the accounting basis remains unknown.
Terribly flawed and growth-at-all-costs contain judgments that financial statements and error measurements cannot fully settle.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable records for the target period establish that commercial generative AI generally failed to earn an overall profit, while representative evaluations establish material product failures.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records establish general profitability, or representative evaluations defeat the asserted material reliability problems. A profitable parent company or isolated successful task is insufficient.
